items.q: How does the ordering process work?
items.a: It's simple! Fill in our online form with your internship details, choose the desired service, then pay half (50%) to start. We handle the writing and deliver the finalized report. The balance is paid upon delivery.

items.q: How long will it take to receive my report?
items.a: The delivery time depends on the complexity and length of the report. Generally, expect between 5 to 10 business days. We'll keep you updated on progress via WhatsApp.

whyChooseUs.newsSubtitle: Recent, verifiable facts that show why trusting your report to AI is risky.

news.title: AI Act — Mandatory watermarks
news.desc: The European Union requires all AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) to embed invisible watermarks in their text. These digital fingerprints allow tracing the origin of any generated document.

news.title: Google's SynthID — Invisible fingerprint
news.desc: Google deployed SynthID, a technology that inserts an imperceptible statistical fingerprint in every text generated by its models. Universities are equipping themselves with compatible detectors.

news.title: Universities on high alert
news.desc: Harvard, Oxford, and many universities classify undisclosed AI use as academic fraud, punishable by permanent expulsion or a permanent mark on the student's record.

news.title: Paraphrasing isn't enough anymore
news.desc: Even rewriting and paraphrasing tools don't always remove statistical watermarks. The AI Act makes AI providers responsible for the traceability of their content.
